items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra. Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra. Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra.

ctx.x: Well, I guess there were signs on the side of the wagon. Oh, sure. That's right. What would it say, for example? I mean, how would it read, you know, for that dance, you know? What would the sign say?

Well, sign would say, on Monday, the date, dance given by the Wolves Club. They had a Wolves Forest Club over the river. Oh, yeah. Which they had a hall, too. They called a Wolves Forest. But these boys, they would throw a dance often at the Come Clean Hall. I see. Was that hand-painted design or printed or? Oh, yeah, hand-painted. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Crescent. Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra. Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra. Jack Carrier's Crescent Orchestra. Yeah. How much did they charge for those dances?…
Oh, them prices. They're doing them things. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
